subject: Pricing follow-up: Nimbus ask for volume match vs OpenAI
messages:
From: Sarah Park <sarah.park@nimbus.ai>
To: aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@nimbus.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Quick: pricing match request (we have lower offer)

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with latency and traceability. We ran final pricing checks this morning and had a competing offer from OpenAI that looks materially cheaper on per-token for our steady-state volumes. They quoted $0.00035/token for text-gen with a 12-month commit and an annual true-up.

We prefer Redwood for the performance and control, but the finance team will need a comparable run-rate to move forward. Can you confirm whether Redwood can match or come within 5% of that price at our projected 1.2M tokens/month? We are evaluating a 12-month term and are open to a phased ramp if you need it.

Attached is the competitive quote for reference. Looking for a quick yes/no so we can finalize procurement timeline — ideally by end of week.

Best,
Sarah
Director of Platform Engineering
Nimbus Analytics

Attachment: nimbus-competitive-quote.pdf (pdf, 45KB)

From: aditya.rao@redwood.ai <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Park <sarah.park@nimbus.ai>
Cc: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@nimbus.ai>, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 12:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick: pricing match request (we have lower offer)

Hi Sarah — appreciate the transparency and the quick turnaround.

Short answer: yes — we can get to parity with a structured commit. I need to confirm final approval with finance for the exact per-token level, but here are the practical options enabling a match:

- Option A (12-month firm commit): 1.2M tokens/month, $0.000345/token net (paid monthly), 1% overage at the same rate. Includes standard SLAs and telemetry retention 90 days.
- Option B (9–12 month ramp): 6-month ramp to the committed volume with blended pricing that reaches $0.00036/token by month 4. Useful if you want lower upfront commitment.
- Option C (no commit): On-demand at $0.0005/token.

I'm cc'ing Laura (sales manager) to confirm discounts and Rishi from pricing to sign off on the exact net rate. If Option A looks good, I can send a tracked proposal + DocuSign for a 12-month agreement today.

Next step: Laura/Rishi — can you confirm green light for $0.000345/token on a 12-month 1.2M monthly commit? I'll include our standard audit/KMS language and a one-time migration credit to offset switching costs.

Sarah — if you prefer, we can schedule a 20-minute call to walk the economics vs OpenAI and show how caching/prefix reuse reduces your real token burn.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: redwood-pricing-comparison-vs-openai.xlsx

From: laura.bennett@redwood.ai <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: aditya.rao@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pricing follow-up: Nimbus ask for volume match vs OpenAI

Forwarding for official sign-off.

Aditya — details look reasonable but need finance ok on the net unit economics. Rishi, please confirm: 1.2M/mo x 12 months at $0.000345/token plus a $5k one-time migration credit — acceptable? Also confirm whether we require a minimum ARR threshold for this concession or standard T&Cs.

I recommend we accept with a clause: 30-day performance exit (if latency or SLOs degrade vs demo) to protect support load.

Laura
Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

----Original attached: redwood-proposal-nimbus-1yr-commit.xlsx

From: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 15:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pricing follow-up: Nimbus ask for volume match vs OpenAI

Quick internal note / approval: finance reviewed projections and the proposed structure is OK with the following controls: 

- Approve Option A: 1.2M tokens/mo, 12-month term at $0.000345/token net (effective monthly billing).
- Include a $5,000 one-time migration credit applied to first invoice.
- Add a clause for annual true-up if actual usage exceeds committed volume by more than 20% (protects against unbounded high consumption).
- Require a signed SOW that lists expected monthly patterns and a contact for load-related escalations.

I also want to flag that if they later request additional enterprise features (longer retention, private deploy), we should convert to a reserved capacity quote (higher NRR). For this deal now: green to proceed.

Rishi
Head of Pricing & Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference

Attachment: internal-pricing-approval-note.txt

From: aditya.rao@redwood.ai <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Park <sarah.park@nimbus.ai>, Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@nimbus.ai>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 14 May 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick: pricing match request (we have lower offer)

Hi Sarah / Tom — thanks for waiting. Great news: we can match the OpenAI run-rate with a small administrative structure.

Offer (final):
- Commitment: 1.2M tokens/month, 12-month term
- Net rate: $0.000345 per token (billed monthly)
- One-time migration credit: $5,000 applied to first invoice
- Overage: 1% allowance then billed at same net rate; annual true-up if usage exceeds committed volume by >20%
- SLA: 99.9% uptime for hosted API region, 90-day telemetry retention

Next steps: I will upload the tracked proposal and send a DocuSign. If that works, we can have a signed agreement by next Wednesday and schedule a short onboarding call with our Solutions Engineer.

DocuSign (proposal + SOW): https://app.docusign.com/REDWOOD/NIM-2026-0423
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567

Please reply with a quick thumbs up if you want me to send the DocuSign now. Happy to jump on a 20-minute call to walk the SLOs and caching behavior that will reduce your token consumption in production.

Thanks,
Aditya
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Attachment: 2026-05-14-redwood-final-proposal.pdf
